## MemPalace vs Obsidian: not competitors, a stack
It gives the agent a way to index, search, and retrieve the right memories at the right time using local ChromaDB and SQLite.

| Layer | Role | Why it matters |
|-|-|-|
| Obsidian | Human-readable memory substrate | Your notes remain local, portable, and inspectable |
| Sovereign Markdown | File format | The memory is not trapped in a vendor database |
| MemPalace | AI retrieval layer | The agent can search memories without context bloat |
| Local ChromaDB + SQLite | Index and storage | Recall happens locally instead of through a rented cloud brain |

## Frequently Asked Questions
Local-first memory keeps the AI's reasoning substrate on your own hardware instead of rented infrastructure.

web.description:
## Roda
Local First

# I’m Turning Obsidian Into a Memory OS for AI Agents
A local-first loop where agents read, write, check, and evolve memory in plain Markdown.

You want it to ingest useful material, query the right notes before work, and lint the memory so it does not quietly rot.

A memory closeout skill teaches the agent how to write back.

I can open it, edit it, delete nothing blindly, and understand what the agent thinks it knows.

It tells the agent: do not save raw transcripts, do not store secrets, do not dump everything.

## Get Roda’s stories in your inbox
It is the piece I want other people to be able to reuse: take a meaningful conversation, extract durable memory, write it into an Obsidian vault, refresh the graph, and avoid storing noise.

A loop where agents read before they work, write after they learn, keep memory human-readable, and expose enough of their reasoning surface that we can actually trust what they are using.
